user.title: New rhythm
user.description: A rhythm is one daily schedule, for example for the flat, a terrarium or a child's room. Times of day, day models and the week plan are set up on the **Maestro** page in the sidebar.

options.day: A typical day: wake up, morning, midday, afternoon, evening, bedtime
options.empty: One time of day, to build your own

condition_type.is: The time of day is one of

pin.name: Pin a time of day
pin.description: Sets a time of day of today's model, or the base state, until a chosen end. Pinning the current time of day holds it. A new pin replaces the previous one.

time_of_day.name: Time of day
time_of_day.description: The key of the time of day, for example einschlafen. The Maestro page shows every key.

until.name: End
until.description: Until the next change: until the plan begins a later time of day or the day ends. A duration or a time ends when the next day begins at the latest.

resume.name: Back to the plan
resume.description: Ends a pin. Day adjustments stay.

adjust_day.name: Adjust a day
adjust_day.description: Changes a single date: another day model, other start times, another day end. Only what you name changes, the rest follows the model.

date.name: Date
date.description: Without a date, today. Before a day begins, today is the coming day.

model.name: Day model
model.description: The key of another day model for this date.

times.name: Start times
times.description: Times of day with new start times, for example einschlafen: 23:30. Add +1 for the following day, for example 01:00+1.

end.name: Day end
end.description: A new day end, for example 00:30+1.

clear_day.name: Remove a day adjustment
clear_day.description: The date follows the plan again.

refresh_calendars.name: Read calendars again
refresh_calendars.description: Reads the linked calendars at once instead of at the next regular update.
